name: Supergood Solutions
description: Public read endpoints for Supergood's rate card and services, plus a fit-check POST that emails Ryan Sandoval. There is also an MCP server (card: https://supergood.solutions/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json). This file is not an A2A JSON-RPC server. Call the HTTP API in https://supergood.solutions/openapi.json.

skills.name: Read the rate card
skills.description: GET https://supergood.solutions/pricing.json. No key. Returns the full rate card in one JSON document.
examples: What does Supergood charge for a Quick Scan?

skills.name: Read the service list
skills.description: GET https://supergood.solutions/services.json. No key. Returns the five public services in one JSON document.
examples: Which Supergood service covers agent guardrails?

skills.name: Submit a fit check
skills.description: POST https://api.supergood.solutions/api/intake. No key. Sends one real email to Ryan. Required JSON fields are name, email, and handoff. paysForTools (Yes, Not sure, No) is asked on the form and required by the MCP tool.
examples: Send a fit check for a Monday report the team rebuilds by hand.

skills.name: Use the MCP server
skills.description: Streamable HTTP at https://api.supergood.solutions/api/mcp. No key. Tools: get_pricing, get_services, submit_fit_check. Server card: https://supergood.solutions/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
